title: Each corner of a shape can be rounded on its own
goal: Corner Radius rounds all four corners of a shape by the same amount, and there is no way to round only some of them. A card with a rounded top and a square bottom, a segmented control whose two ends are round and whose middle is square, a speech bubble: none of them can be drawn without faking it with a second shape on top. Let a person open the one number into four and set each corner.
notes:
CAPABILITY GAP. Sources/PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift carries one radius per layer, and the panel draws it as a single slider (visible in queue/manager/shots/2026-09-08-2215-versions.png, Appearance, Corner Radius 18 pt). Nothing in PhotonzCore models a per corner radius.

This finishes a control the user already uses rather than adding a new surface, so it needs no decision card. What DOES need care is that it must not cost the common case: the single number stays the default face and opening it into four is a deliberate act, the same shape as GroupPadding in Sources/PhotonzCore/GroupLayout.swift, which is one number that opens into four sides. Copy that model, its Codable behaviour and its panel treatment rather than inventing a second idiom.

Everything that reads the radius has to follow: the fill, the ring (Sources/PhotonzCore/RingShape.swift), the selection outline (SelectionOutlineShape.swift, which learned to follow a rounded shape on 2026-09-08), and clipping. Sources/PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift already knows which layers have corners at all, so the row keeps hiding itself where there are none.

Flag: next-shape-parts (FeatureCatalog.shapePartsFlag), on by default in Next.
acceptance: A shape with corners can be given a different radius on each of its four corners, and the one number is still the way in: nobody who wants all four the same has to type four numbers
The shape, its border, its selection outline and anything it clips all follow the four numbers, not just the fill
A document saved with four different corners opens with them, and a document saved before this opens unchanged
Try it: Experiments window, Next release, Appearance is what it is Effects is what you add is on by default. Draw a rectangle, open Corner Radius into its four corners, and round the top two only
An audit is written under queue/audits/ with a real window capture, and anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task

log.note: Pre-build adversarial review. (1) The Corner Radius row is a SLIDER, not a number field like Padding, so 'open into four' cannot be four more sliders: that is four knobs and ~120pt of panel for a thing you set once. It opens into four small number fields, the way Padding does, with the slider staying the closed face. (2) Following Padding exactly: closed and disagreeing, the readout shows the four numbers themselves (18/18/0/0) rather than the word Mixed, so a corner typed at the bottom is never invisible; and the four do NOT auto-open, because Padding deliberately stopped doing that on 2026-09-04 when the rows ate the panel. (3) Risk the padding row does not have: a slider is easier to knock than a text field, and dragging it while the corners disagree flattens all four. Accepted (one undo step, and the readout warned) but noted for the audit. (4) Corner order is clockwise from the top LEFT (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left), which is what anybody who has typed a CSS border-radius already carries. (5) Overlap: two adjacent corners of 60 on a 100pt edge is not a shape. Rather than clamping each corner to half the short edge on its own, the four are scaled down together by the CSS rule (the worst edge sets one factor), which collapses to exactly today's min(r, min(w,h)/2) when all four agree, so nothing uniform changes. (6) Cut from scope: zoom callout corners, measure pills and caption pills keep their own single radius. They have no user-facing corner control, so four numbers there would be code nobody can reach.

Built. Model: CornerRadii in PhotonzCore, the same bargain GroupPadding makes with a group's four sides — one number is the way in, four underneath, and it SAVES as a single number while they agree so an older document is byte for byte what it was. AnnotationContent and LayerStyle both store it under the key one radius always wrote, so the file format did not fork. Two corners on one edge that would cross are scaled down together by the CSS rule, which collapses to exactly today's min(r, min(w,h)/2) when all four agree. Renderer: one path builder (CornerRadii.path) now serves the shape's fill, its stroke, the mask cut out of a picture or a group, every ring in the Effects list, and the outline round a picked layer. The mask generator keeps the one-filter Core Image fast path whenever the four agree, so a 12 megapixel composite does not start baking bitmaps because per corner rounding exists; only a shape whose corners actually differ pays for a drawn mask.

Post-build review on the probe (Screen Recording granted, real window captures). Fixed one honesty bug found by looking at it: with the four rows OPEN and uneven, the readout still said '34 pt', which claims all four are 34 while the rows underneath say otherwise. It says Mixed there now, and holds the four numbers only when they are SHUT and there is nowhere else to read them — which is exactly what Padding's single field does. Verified live: the shape, its border, the selection outline round it and the shape drawn as a live drag preview all follow the four; the next rectangle drawn arrives wearing them. Left rough and recorded in the audit: pulling the one slider while the corners disagree still flattens them, and there is no way to drag a corner on the canvas.

Release scope: CornerRadiusRow is shared with the panel the release before the Appearance/Effects split uses, so the chevron and the four rows are gated on Experiments.shared.shapePartsEnabled (next-shape-parts, Next only, on by default). The honest READOUT is not gated: a card drawn in Next and opened in Current shows 34/34/0/0 rather than a single number that is not true.

Corner Radius opens into four numbers via a chevron beside its label, the way Padding opens into four sides. New CornerRadii in PhotonzCore (Codable as a single number while the four agree, so older documents open and re-save unchanged); one path builder now drives the shape fill, its stroke, the mask on a picture or group, every Effects border, the selection outline and the live drawing preview. Compositor keeps its one-filter mask for the uniform case, so the common path costs what it always cost. Panel control gated on next-shape-parts (Next only); the readout reads four corners honestly in both releases. 5115 tests green including 20 new CornerRadii tests, 16 per-corner model tests and 6 render tests that composite a real document and read the pixel in from each corner. Tried live on the probe with real window captures; audit at queue/audits/2026-09-08-each-corner-rounded.json.
